First, note the given date: 01-23-1475 means January 23, 1475.  
Subtract 306 days:  

1475 is not a leap year (leap years are divisible by 4, but 1475 mod 4 = 3).  
From Jan 23, go back 23 days to Jan 1, 1475 → 306 - 23 = 283 days left to subtract.  
Now go into 1474:  

1474 is not a leap year (1474 mod 4 = 2).  
Days in 1474 after subtracting 283 days from the end of the year:  
283 days before Jan 1, 1475 = 365 - 283 = 82nd day of 1474 counting from Jan 1.  

82nd day of 1474: Jan 31 (31) + Feb 28 (59) + Mar 23 (82).  

So date is March 23, 1474.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1474-03-23
